notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 Now Live: Respawn Mode and More
notes.content:
Hey ghouls,

Patch 1.0.9 is live today with a mix of new features, balance tweaks, and bug fixes. Here is what you can expect:



Gameplay changes:

Respawn game mode. Come back to life by moving your goo into the yellow circle. Available in Quickplay.

Witch’s Hat grow ability.

Improved critter zone.

Inactive player detection.

Dialog skipping in the tutorial.

Bug fixes and quality of life:

Countdown text thickness fixed.

Trophy material fixed in Riptide Reef.

Persistent ice block after Midas Touch removed.

Improved error, disconnect, and wait tracking.

Various analytics improvements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/1f4fb2552a0166713495eddc949c15c1854035c6.gif"]

We appreciate all the feedback. Keep it coming and we’ll keep making Polterguys the best way to annoy your friends.

– The Polterguys Team

notes.title: Patch 1.08 – Trophy Costume for Weekly Winners and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


Patch 1.08 is now live. If you’ve been gunning for the top spot on the leaderboard, there’s now something to show for it.


New in this patch:
• Weekly leaderboard winners now wear the Trophy costume… for one week only
• News UI rework for cleaner layout
• Fixed gamepad double scrolling in News UI
• Increased shadow resolution

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/d70cff0790c6730fc1eeb43c723b9a1042c56132.gif"]
Congrats to our latest top players - keep an eye out for them wearing their new look this week!



As always, thanks for playing. We welcome any and all feedback.


– The Polterguys Team

notes.title: Patch Update – Weekly Leaderboards Are Here!
notes.content:
Hey fellow ghouls

The new patch is live today and here’s what’s in it:

Weekly leaderboards are in. Compete for the top spot each week.

Quickplay flow rework. Groups now stay together between rounds. Solos can join games in progress.

Haunt decor is cheaper. Candy prices reduced.

New unlockables. Flamingo (Haunt) and Snowman (Riptide Reef 2).

Fixes. Exploits patched. Bugs squashed. Performance improved. Menus cleaned up.

Quality of life. Skippable intro screens. Improved input rebinding. Better region and watermark display.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/1f4fb2552a0166713495eddc949c15c1854035c6.gif"]

Each week's leaderboard winner will get to wear the exclusive costume throughout the following week. It’s not a permanent unlock, but a temporary reward that shifts to whoever holds the top spot.

We’re also planning to award a permanent emote as a separate prize for leaderboard winners - more on that soon.

Catch you on the leaderboard.

– The Polterguys Team

notes.title: Polterguys – What’s New So Far!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Watching players jump into Polterguys: Possession Party, share feedback, and post their favourite moments has been incredible -  and it’s helped us shape the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/5dfee495eb33bd17106faf90c3d1df45ba8f162e.jpg

Here’s a look at the updates we’ve rolled out so far:

🔧 Patch 1.0.2 – April 22, 2025
• Fixed several camping spots
• Added a pause button for the staging area countdown
• Resolved scoring issues

🔧 Patch 1.0.3 – May 2, 2025
• Embeautification of network stats
• Random level selection option added to Custom Games
• Custom Game menu now remembers your settings between matches
• Fixed 2- and 3-star costume abilities
• Fixed level exploits
• Disabled big possessable cameras
• Fixed issues with daily quests
• Fixed UI issue when disabling abilities
• Fixed costume quest rewards
• Soda can shake bug resolved
• Improved AI pathing in Holiday Hoarders
• Fixed penguin AI
• AI now avoids oven monster in Too Many Ghouls
• Fixed clearsight issue in the furnace level

🔧 Patch 1.0.4 – May 14, 2025
• Level Shuffle option added to Custom Games
• Improved AI behavior
• More fixes to level exploits
• Further costume ability fixes
• Camera tweaks on large interactable objects
• Localization updates
• Ongoing polish and stability improvements



We’ve been busy behind the scenes too - and while this post is all about what’s already live, we’ve got more improvements and features coming soon 👀

Please keep your feedback coming - it really does help. And if you’ve been enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave a review on Steam!

Thanks again for playing,

The Polterguys Team

notes.title: Polterguys: Possession Party is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Polterguys: Possession Party has officially launched!

 The full game is now live, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you!

A huge thank you to everyone who played the demo, provided feedback, or supported us along the way — your contributions have been invaluable in shaping Polterguys into what it is today.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/7fa5eb489ea5c2083364b77d2520ccbd59e1433e.jpg


Here’s what you can enjoy right now:


 Ten unique levels, each with its own surprises and challenges
 Online matches for up to 8 players, plus local split-screen
 Plenty of customisation, unlockable costumes, and in-game challenges


But this is only the beginning! We’re already looking ahead and planning new content, and we’ll be reaching out to the community to hear your thoughts on what comes next. 

Whether it's additional levels, new modes, or something else entirely, your feedback will help guide what we work on in the future.

We’re also busy working on the first patch based on your feedback — more details will be shared soon.
Thank you once again for your support. 

We can’t wait to see how you experience everything Polterguys has to offer!
— The Madorium & Amplified Games Teams

notes.title: EGX London 2022 Wrap Up!
notes.content:
First and Foremost: Thank You!

After a little bit of recovery from the show, its time for an update!

This was a very exciting and nerve-wracking time for Madorium; taking our game to a show for the first time, running the game on a moderately untested method (LAN) , and having to really talk to people out in the real world for the first time in years! And with all those things considered, we were beyond ecstatic with the feedback and the appreciation that we and the game received while at EGX London this year!

We were lucky to see an incredibly diverse set of people across all ages have a try at Polterguys and be able to enjoy it; and a number of those would come back later with their friends to compete with them head to head! Some of our absolute favorite moments were when a group of friends would play and start competing with each other, and be able to see people having a laugh the whole time.. even if the monster surprised them from the top of the bridge! 

On the second day of the show, we were already starting to hear people being recommended over to us from a variety of sources - even from representatives at booths demoing other games! 👻 And for that, we give our utmost thanks to those who were so kind to tell their friends and anyone else at the show about our game! There was hardly ever a lull, and almost always a queue, to be able to play our game! And that's because of all of you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/eff1cb3a4eaf288051ec59ec205587fe5fbc5fc5.jpg

What's Next?

As for what's next for Polterguys.. we are in the process of trying to secure a path towards release, to try and grow this community, and to find new ways and events where we can get the game into people's hands as soon as possible!

While we were at the show, we were able to observe people playing the game for the very first time, and did our best in paying attention to any potential barriers that new players had when playing our game. When demoing at the expo, at least in its current state, we mostly had a trial by fire way of showing people how to play; we wanted people in the chaos and fun as quickly as possible! With this approach though, we found that for a portion of players, they were able to pick up most things the experience had to offer fairly quickly; however, this was certainly not the case for everyone who gave Polterguys a play.

We want the game to be rewarding to all players, and for them to experiment some and learn things as they play, but also not be at a major disadvantage if they don't know all the mechanics. There were a few nuances to the game that there wasn't time to share during a demo such as one at EGX, but we hope these are things that players discover in the future and can help enrich the experience. We also want to keep the experience open for players to play in a way that suits them best.. be that aggressive, hiding, constantly running, etc. We want the game to have a steady learning curve and fun at every stage, rather than a steep learning curve like you might experience jumping into our demo at EGX. We have collected our notes and feedback from EGX and are already looking at ways to smooth out this experience for new players in these situations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/ad39ac40820c7179db5925da201ec5a89fc929c4.jpg

Future Engagements

Going forwards from this point-of-no-return where we have shared our game to the world for the first time... We are hoping to open up the development process a bit more to the community and grow and build Polterguys from there!

We are planning to share more content across all of our socials, streaming development/play-tests over Twitch, engaging with the community for feature requests or suggestions or feedback on current things we are working on, etc. At EGX we got to see people enjoy the game as much as we have for a while now, and can't wait to share more of what we have planned and try to engage with the community.

For now, just keep an eye on our socials and here on Steam for any upcoming news and events! Our socials are all found at the handle @PolterguysGame, and we will do our best to keep updates coming while keeping our heads down on developing Polterguys further! And if you haven't already, be sure to wishlist the game! 

Thank you all again for the support and spending part of your time at EGX trying out our game! The response has exceeded our expectations at this point. Reach out if you have any questions or feedback!


Until next time,
Stay spooky everyone!
